data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month, independently of others. Each of the other 24: please opt in individually—state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, leaving250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even all25 at18 leave50, but recovery to500 isn't guaranteed. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. This needn't maximize long-run income.
